# Phil Gordon & Priscilla Grant

- [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) — Friend of — [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) — college friends and companions · since v3  <sub>[v3 ch.Lady P60](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0060), [v3 ch.Home P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) go to register at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) and feel overwhelmed and insignificant. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Old St. John's Cemetery, where she and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) meet [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), who eagerly strikes up a conversation and introduces herself.
>
> — v3 · Chapter IV April’s Lady

_Sources: [v3 ch.Lady P2](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0002), [v3 ch.Lady P5](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0005), [v3 ch.Lady P21](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0021), [v3 ch.Lady P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028)_

> [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) chats lightly with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) about her suitors, her hesitations about [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), and her fear of marriage before they explore an old graveyard together. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) pauses at the grave of an eighteen-year-old midshipman and leaves a small cluster of pansies on it. Afterwards, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) reflect on Philippa's charming, innocent nature compared to [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md).
>
> — v3 · Chapter IV April’s Lady

_Sources: [v3 ch.Lady P48](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0048), [v3 ch.Lady P62](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0062), [v3 ch.Lady P67](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0067), [v3 ch.Lady P71](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0071)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) settle into college life at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) as their freshman class wins the annual Arts Rush under [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) Blythe's leadership. [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) quickly adopts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md), introducing them into Redmond's active social circle. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives a bundle of letters from home—including updates from [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), Ruby, [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md)—which helps connect her old life in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) to her new life in [Kingsport](../codex/places.md#kingsport).
>
> — v3 · Chapter V Letters from Home

_Sources: [v3 ch.Home P0](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0000), [v3 ch.Home P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 ch.Home P7](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0007)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md), Philippa, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and Charlie go for a walk in the park together and admire the autumn foliage and harbour views. On their return route along [Spofford Avenue](../codex/places.md#spofford-avenue), [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) shows them a charming, old-fashioned little house called Patty's Place. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) feels an instant connection to the house and has a presentiment that she will become better acquainted with it.
>
> — v3 · Chapter VI In the Park

_Sources: [v3 ch.Park P14](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0014), [v3 ch.Park P24](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0024), [v3 ch.Park P32](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0032), [v3 ch.Park P40](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0040)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) visit Patty's Place and successfully arrange to rent the house from Miss [Patty](../character/patty.md) Spofford and Miss [Maria](../character/maria.md) Spofford for the upcoming school year. Later, [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) visits them and excitedly asks to join their housekeeping arrangement, agreeing to their conditions regarding chores, plain living, and set caller hours.
>
> — v3 · Chapter X Patty’s Place

_Sources: [v3 ch.Place P0](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0000), [v3 ch.Place P12](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0012), [v3 ch.Place P47](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0047), [v3 ch.Place P59](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0059)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends settle into Patty's Place alongside [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) and her cats, [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) and the [Sarah-cat](../character/sarah-cat.md). Before leaving [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) faces mixed reviews about her published story and adopts a stray cat, [Rusty](../character/rusty.md), whom they fail to chloroform. Eventually, [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) arrives to chaperon the household with a relaxed attitude toward their independence.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XVI Adjusted Relationships

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 ch.Relationships P2](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0002), [v3 ch.Relationships P44](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0044), [v3 ch.Relationships P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053)_

> At Patty's Place, the girls prepare for exams and learn from Miss [Patty](../character/patty.md) that they can rent the house for another year. Later, while out walking, [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) reveals to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that she has accepted Jonas's marriage proposal. As they discuss love and marriage, [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) asks [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md), prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to reflect on her feelings for [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md).
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXVII Mutual Confidences

_Sources: [v3 ch.Confidences P1](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0001), [v3 ch.Confidences P7](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0007), [v3 ch.Confidences P19](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0019), [v3 ch.Confidences P36](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0036)_

> The girls return to Patty's Place for their final year at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), sharing stories and laughs with [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) about their vacations and suitors. Later, while studying during a rainy evening, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md) reminisce over old [Story Club](../codex/factions.md#story-club) manuscripts, leading [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to read a sketch she wrote years before and make a sudden decision.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXV The Last Redmond Year Opens

_Sources: [v3 ch.Opens P0](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0000), [v3 ch.Opens P28](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0028), [v3 ch.Opens P44](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0044), [v3 ch.Opens P46](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0046)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives news that a publisher accepted her sketch, bringing excitement to Patty's Place. While on a walk, [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md) announces his mother and sisters will visit, unnerving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). Roy's family arrives a day early on Friday, creating chaos, but the awkward visit ends with Roy's sister [Dorothy](../character/dorothy.md) bonding with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXVI The Gardners’Call

_Sources: [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P3](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0003), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P17](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0017), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P22](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0022), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P31](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0031)_
